quickEntry.title: Quick entry
quickEntry.description: Type cards as a list — and check them before saving.

assistantHint.title: Cards from a photo? Use the assistant
assistantHint.description: Recognizing a card photo or building a deck for you — the assistant handles that now.

list.label: Card list
list.description: One card per line. Quantity, set code or passcode are detected automatically. Deck lists work too (YDK, ydke://, Omega code, recipe); headings such as “Monster” or “Extra” are skipped.
list.tooManyLines: {count} lines — please process at most {max} at a time.

queueFull.title: The review list is full
queueFull.description: The review list holds {max} lines — {dropped} line was not added. Save the existing lines first. | The review list holds {max} lines — {dropped} lines were not added. Save the existing lines first.

errors.title: That didn't work
errors.empty: Please enter at least one card first.
errors.tooManyLines: Please process at most {max} lines at a time.

defaults.title: Default collection
defaults.description: Applies to every line you don't pick a collection for.

review.title: Check and correct
review.nothingYet: Nothing to check yet — enter some cards as a list first.
review.unresolvedHint: Some lines are still open. Pick a match or remove the line to save everything.
review.nothingResolved: There are no resolved lines to save.

row.conflict: The set code and the name point to different cards — please pick one.
row.noSuggestions: No suggestions — please search the catalog.

justSaved.title: Just saved
justSaved.description: {count} copy is in your inventory now. You can move it to another collection without reading the list in again. | {count} copies are in your inventory now. You can move them to another collection without reading the list in again.
